examples.arabic: رايت بائعين كثيرين وناسا يشترون الخضروات والفواكه
examples.english: I saw many sellers and people buying vegetables and fruits.
examples.transliteration: Ra'aytu bā'i'īn kathīrīn wa nāsan yashtarūna al-khaḍrawāt wa al-fawākih
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.english: An honorable man sold fresh fruits
